guidance_text: When the question asks for a previous/next/before/after item, such as "which title is listed previous to O Janewale" or "what was before X", first locate the anchor row by exact cell match, then move by displayed row order and project the requested column; avoid sort by a value column unless the question explicitly says highest/lowest/max/min.
validation_slice: WTQ/SQA questions with previous|next|before|after plus an anchor entity

guidance_text: When the requested answer is a name/title/entity role, such as ship name, episode title, team, player, school, route name, or symbol name, select the name/title/entity column; never output an identifier, code, number, rank, glyph, seed, or position column unless the question explicitly asks for that identifier role.
validation_slice: questions with entity-role terms and identifier/rank/code columns

guidance_text: When the target column is rank/place/position/seed/pick/chart position, including chart columns such as GER/UK/US peak position, treat it as an ordinal where smaller usually means earlier/better; avoid add, average, or compare it as a magnitude unless the question explicitly asks arithmetic over ranks.

When a sports/match/game table has score/result cells like 18-12, 14-14, 58-13, or 2-1 and the question asks for the result/score, return the complete score string exactly as the table gives it; split or subtract the score only when the question asks for margin, difference, winner side, loser side, total, or comparison.
validation_slice: sports score/result lookup vs margin/difference questions

guidance_text: For follow-up wording that refers to prior answers, such as these ships, of these, those countries, their titles, among them, or which one, first restrict candidate rows to the previous answer set; avoid scan the whole table until this active-set filter has been applied.
validation_slice: SQA follow-up turns with deictic references to prior answers

guidance_text: After resolving active rows from history, project only the newly requested column or role, such as cost from Est. building cost, country from Country, or date from Launched; avoid repeat the previous answer role, return the matched value, or return whole rows.
validation_slice: SQA follow-up turns asking for attributes of prior answers

guidance_text: When the question asks one property for each active item, such as their dates, these teams, which ones, or what countries, output one answer per active item in active-set order; avoid collapse duplicates or stop after the first matching row.
validation_slice: SQA follow-ups with multi-answer gold or prior answer cardinality > 1

guidance_text: Before any numeric operation, bind the exact metric column named by the question, including unit and year qualifiers, such as GDP per capita as of 2012 (PPP), population density (/ km2), floors, or gap from Thailand; avoid compute over a neighboring metric column with similar numbers.
validation_slice: TableBench NumericalReasoning with multiple numeric metric columns

guidance_text: For average/sum/total questions, such as average population density of all municipalities or average floors from 1895 to 1980, enumerate all rows satisfying the stated filters, then aggregate exactly those rows; avoid aggregate only visible preview rows, headers, totals, or examples.
validation_slice: TableBench aggregation and time-based calculation questions

guidance_text: When the question asks which/who/economy/entity has an extreme metric, such as which economy had the highest GDP per capita as of 2012, sort/filter by the metric column but return the entity column, e.g. Singapore; avoid return the numeric metric value unless the question asks for the value.
validation_slice: ranking questions where gold answer is an entity name

guidance_text: Before selecting a HiTab cell, resolve its full row-header path and column-header path, including parent group labels and unit rows such as for thousand women, fiscal year, R&D expenditure, cases, percentage, or population; avoid compare or project a cell using only its leaf header.
validation_slice: HiTab examples with hierarchical headers or linked cell paths

guidance_text: For pairwise comparison questions, such as Quebec or Ontario, experienced enterprises or total average, higher/lower/more/less, compare only the two named candidates under the same indicator and unit, then return the winning candidate label from the table; avoid return the compared numeric cell unless the question asks for the value.

When the referenced value or answer formula is negative, such as answer formula =-B6 or a table cell -630, preserve the sign exactly unless the question asks for an absolute magnitude; avoid strip, invert, or explain away the sign.
validation_slice: HiTab opposite/negative formula examples and negative-value tables
